releases.title: iNNFam Android Early Access
notes: Official Android early access build distributed by Gree Software Company.
Released for testing and sustained everyday use. Features and behaviour may change as tester feedback is reviewed.

releases.title: iNNFam Android Early Access - build 3
notes: Improved chat refresh and notification-to-chat handling.
Added the public App Updates page, release history, and browser-based APK download action.
Android version 0.1.0, build 3; the APK filename is a distribution label. Expo OTA updates are disabled in this build.

releases.title: iNNFam Android Early Access - build 6
notes: Enabled compatible Expo OTA updates on the production channel with an Android fingerprint runtime.
Compatible downloaded updates can apply on a subsequent cold launch. The previous Updates screen remains embedded; its simplification is delivered separately through OTA.
Android version 0.1.1, build 6; innfam-v1.1.1.apk is a distribution filename. No additional native permissions were added.
